summary: WI-556 implementation correctly delivers the final-SHA mandatory-skill coverage contract (AC-1..AC-10) with content-addressed indexing, tamper-resistant recomputation in check-chain-receipts, presence-gated zero-cost execution for legacy commits, and atomic merge finalization with exit-code contract 0/2/3. Three medium/low findings noted around row result accounting during child verification failures, slot phase prefix matching during finalization, and CLI verdict string formatting.

findings.claim: verifyCoverage row result erroneously reports PASS when child receipt type, WI, or slot SHA check fails
findings.analysis: In scripts/lib/skill-coverage.mjs verifyCoverage(), lines 2988-2990 evaluate child.receipt_type, child.wi, and slotSha matching, invoking fail() on mismatch. Line 2991 then sets 'beforeLen = reasons.length' immediately prior to checking receipt_sha256 digest matching. If any of the preceding three checks failed but receipt_sha256 matches, 'reasons.length === beforeLen' evaluates to true at line 2993, causing rows.push to report result: 'PASS' and detail: '... slot verified' for that row in the coverage table despite the child validation failures. The overall verifyCoverage verdict correctly returns 'no', but the individual row verdict in rows[] is misleading.
findings.proposed_fix: Capture the pre-item reason count before line 2988 (e.g. const itemBeforeLen = reasons.length;) and evaluate row result at line 2993 with 'reasons.length === itemBeforeLen ? "PASS" : "INVALID"'.

findings.claim: Merge finalizer child slot resolution only recognizes bare slots and ::P3 phase suffix
findings.analysis: In scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs lines 3125-3129, when compiling required entries from remapped child slots, matchedKey checks childBySlot.has(baseSlot) followed only by childBySlot.has(`${baseSlot}::P3`). If a producer receipt slot carries any other phase suffix (e.g. ::P1, ::P5, or custom phase identifiers), matchedKey evaluates to null and falls back to baseSlot, which does not exist in remapped. Consequently, receipt_sha256 is omitted and post-merge verification in check-chain-receipts fails with 'child receipt slot missing', causing merge finalization to exit 3 (MERGED_UNVERIFIED).
findings.proposed_fix: Resolve child slots by prefix matching across childBySlot keys: const matchedKey = childBySlot.has(baseSlot) ? baseSlot : ([...childBySlot.keys()].find((k) => k.startsWith(`${baseSlot}::`)) || null);

findings.claim: --coverage mode maps passing check results to 'pass' instead of 'YES', printing verdict=PASS instead of verdict=YES
findings.analysis: In scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs line 1240, main() renders coverage tables by mapping row.ok to verdict: verdict === 'YES' ? 'pass' : ... before calling renderCoverageTable. In scripts/lib/skill-coverage.mjs line 3008, renderCoverageTable prints result.verdict.toUpperCase(), outputting 'verdict=PASS' rather than the canonical 'verdict=YES' specified in the WI-556 Goal and AC-2 specification table.
findings.proposed_fix: Pass verdict: verdict.toLowerCase() or pass { verdict: row.ok ? 'yes' : ... } so renderCoverageTable prints verdict=YES / verdict=NO / verdict=UNKNOWN.
